title: rpl_route_state_vectors test fails on main: withdrawal_tombstone timing
description:
The rpl_route_state_vectors test fails on main branch (before any changes):

- withdrawal_tombstone_not_reclaimed_early expects accepted=false but Rust returns true
- zero_length_transit test also fails with assertion mismatch

This appears to be a pre-existing issue with either:
1. The test vector expectations
2. The Rust DaoManager tombstone reclamation timing
3. Test vector format version mismatch

The test fixtures also use fd00::/8 addresses when LICHEN spec says 0200::/7 (Yggdrasil), which may indicate the vectors need updating.
close_reason: Fixed target_active_until() fold initial value: Some(0) → Some(fallback) where fallback=now_seconds. Withdrawn routes now use withdrawal time for tombstone retention, not epoch 0.
